text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The new constitution was promulgated by a presidential decree. Story refers to President Liamine Zeroual signing on Saturday into law of constitutional reforms which will ban political parties based on religion or language.
- The National Transitional Council (quasi-parliament) examines the 1997 draft budget.
- University teachers wages to be increased.

- After the recent massacres, inhabitants of Benachour flee their hometown. Story refers to killings near Blida in which a total of 29 people were slain in two night attacks blamed on Moslem fundamentalists by security forces.
- Strike in universities...Teachers to hold a national meeting at Algiers central university to discuss their demands.
- Those responsible for the massacre at Benachour have been identified.
- President Liamine Zeroual signs the revised constitution into law...Everybody should respect the nation's will.
